verdicts.note: as + 原級 + as. tall.
than → comparative heavier.
the ... in Japan → superlative highest.
long adj → more difficult.
比較対象は無冠詞不可算 money.
the most popular superlative.
not as + 原級 + as → big.
good → better than.
the best ... I have ever seen → superlative best.
much + comparative hotter.
adverb than → faster.
one of the + superlative + plural → oldest.
The more..., the more... 構文.
比較級 and 比較級: warmer and warmer.
No other ... as + 原級 + as → kind.

verdicts.produced_sentence: She swims as fast as me.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: 格式の as I (do) も正しいが tokens は me 固定。
verdicts.note: as ... as 同等比較。tokens から成立。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
verdicts.note: more + interesting + than。

verdicts.produced_sentence: He is the tallest student in the class.
verdicts.note: the tallest student in the class。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Tokyo is one of the largest cities in Japan.
verdicts.note: one of the + superlative + plural noun。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This question is much easier than that one.
verdicts.note: much + comparative 強調。
逆向き比較 shorter。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Your bike is newer than my bike.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: than mine も可だが指示で my bike と your bike を使用。
verdicts.note: 逆向き newer。

verdicts.produced_sentence: That river is not as long as this river.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: not so long as も可。
verdicts.note: longer→not as long as、主語 that river。

verdicts.produced_sentence: No other girl in the village is as beautiful as Ann.
verdicts.note: 最上級 → No other ... as ... as。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Soccer is the most popular sport in this class.
verdicts.note: than any other → 最上級 the most popular。
